analysis_request_attribution.name: analysis_request_attribution
analysis_request_attribution.value: "ai_requests"."style_analysis_version_id" is null or ("ai_requests"."operation"='style-analysis/v1' and "ai_requests"."generation_id" is null and "ai_requests"."attempt_number"=1 and "ai_requests"."parent_request_id" is null)

ai_nonnegative.name: ai_nonnegative
ai_nonnegative.value: "ai_requests"."attempt_number">0 and "ai_requests"."reserved_nanos">=0 and "ai_requests"."estimated_nanos">=0 and "ai_requests"."actual_nanos">=0 and "ai_requests"."duration_ms">=0 and "ai_requests"."input_tokens">=0 and "ai_requests"."output_tokens">=0 and "ai_requests"."total_tokens">=0 and "ai_requests"."reasoning_tokens">=0 and "ai_requests"."cached_tokens">=0

document_design_bounds.name: document_design_bounds
document_design_bounds.value: "document_designs"."revision" >= 0 and length(trim("document_designs"."name")) between 1 and 100 and jsonb_typeof("document_designs"."configuration") = 'object' and "document_designs"."configuration"->>'contractVersion' = 'document-design/v1' and octet_length("document_designs"."configuration"::text) <= 8192

document_snapshot_bounds.name: document_snapshot_bounds
document_snapshot_bounds.value: "document_snapshots"."design_revision">=0 and "document_snapshots"."snapshot_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and jsonb_typeof("document_snapshots"."payload")='object' and ("document_snapshots"."payload"->>'contractVersion') is not distinct from 'document-snapshot/v1' and octet_length("document_snapshots"."payload"::text)<=650000

production_execution_binding.name: production_execution_binding
production_execution_binding.value:
(
    ("production_queue"."generation_command_key" is null and "production_queue"."state" in ('QUEUED','CLAIMED','SKIPPED') and "production_queue"."generation_id" is null and "production_queue"."execution_started_at" is null)
    or ("production_queue"."generation_command_key"="production_queue"."id" and "production_queue"."generation_command_key" is not null and "production_queue"."execution_started_at" is not null)
  ) and "production_queue"."execution_attempt" between 1 and 3 and (("production_queue"."execution_attempt"=1 and "production_queue"."retry_command_key" is null) or ("production_queue"."execution_attempt">1 and "production_queue"."retry_command_key" is not null and "production_queue"."retry_command_key"<>"production_queue"."id" and "production_queue"."generation_id" is not null))

production_claim_metadata.name: production_claim_metadata
production_claim_metadata.value:
(
    ("production_queue"."state"='QUEUED' and "production_queue"."claim_token" is null and "production_queue"."claimed_at" is null and "production_queue"."claim_expires_at" is null and "production_queue"."scheduling_ordinal" is null and "production_queue"."resolved_at" is null and "production_queue"."resolution_code" is null)
    or ("production_queue"."state" in ('CLAIMED','EXECUTING') and "production_queue"."claim_token" is not null and "production_queue"."claimed_at" is not null and "production_queue"."claim_expires_at" is not null and "production_queue"."claim_expires_at">"production_queue"."claimed_at" and "production_queue"."scheduling_ordinal" is not null and "production_queue"."scheduling_ordinal">0 and "production_queue"."resolved_at" is null and "production_queue"."resolution_code" is null)
    or ("production_queue"."state" in ('COMPLETED','ATTENTION','RETRY_WAIT') and "production_queue"."claim_token" is not null and "production_queue"."claimed_at" is not null and "production_queue"."claim_expires_at" is null and "production_queue"."resolved_at" is not null and "production_queue"."resolution_code" is not null and "production_queue"."scheduling_ordinal" is not null and "production_queue"."scheduling_ordinal">0 and ("production_queue"."state"<>'COMPLETED' or "production_queue"."generation_id" is not null))
    or ("production_queue"."state"='SKIPPED'  and "production_queue"."claim_token" is null and "production_queue"."claim_expires_at" is null and "production_queue"."resolved_at" is not null and "production_queue"."resolution_code" is not null and "production_queue"."scheduling_ordinal" is not null and "production_queue"."scheduling_ordinal">0)
  )

production_queue_urgency.name: production_queue_urgency
production_queue_urgency.value: "production_queue"."priority_class" in ('STANDARD','EXPRESS') and ("production_queue"."target_completion_minutes" is null or "production_queue"."target_completion_minutes" between 1 and 525600) and (("production_queue"."target_completion_minutes" is null)=("production_queue"."target_deadline" is null))

review_approval_complete.name: review_approval_complete
review_approval_complete.value: ("reading_reviews"."state"='PENDING' AND "reading_reviews"."approved_by_user_id" IS NULL AND "reading_reviews"."approved_content" IS NULL AND "reading_reviews"."approved_draft_revision" IS NULL AND "reading_reviews"."approved_content_hash" IS NULL AND "reading_reviews"."approved_at" IS NULL) OR ("reading_reviews"."state"='APPROVED' AND "reading_reviews"."approved_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reading_reviews"."approved_content" IS NOT NULL AND "reading_reviews"."approved_content_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "reading_reviews"."approved_content_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' AND "reading_reviews"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND ("reading_reviews"."approved_draft_revision" IS NULL OR "reading_reviews"."approved_draft_revision">=0))

analysis_execution_metadata.name: analysis_execution_metadata
analysis_execution_metadata.value: ("style_analysis_versions"."command_key" is null and "style_analysis_versions"."command_hash" is null and "style_analysis_versions"."input_manifest" is null) or ("style_analysis_versions"."command_key" is not null and "style_analysis_versions"."command_hash" is not null and "style_analysis_versions"."command_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' and "style_analysis_versions"."input_manifest" is not null)

analysis_lifecycle.name: analysis_lifecycle
analysis_lifecycle.value:
"style_analysis_versions"."status" in ('DRAFT','PENDING','ANALYZING','READY','FAILED') and
 (("style_analysis_versions"."status" in ('READY','FAILED'))=("style_analysis_versions"."completed_at" is not null)) and
 (("style_analysis_versions"."status"='READY')=("style_analysis_versions"."payload" is not null)) and (("style_analysis_versions"."status"='FAILED')=("style_analysis_versions"."failure_code" is not null)) and
 ("style_analysis_versions"."status"<>'ANALYZING' or "style_analysis_versions"."started_at" is not null) and
 ("style_analysis_versions"."failure_code" is null or "style_analysis_versions"."failure_code" in ('INVALID_RESULT','PROVIDER_FAILURE','CANCELED','INTERNAL_FAILURE','POLICY_REJECTED','BUDGET_REJECTED','AMBIGUOUS_EXECUTION'))

source_text_valid.name: source_text_valid
source_text_valid.value: "style_sources"."source_type"='PASTED_TEXT' and length(trim("style_sources"."title")) between 1 and 150 and length(trim("style_sources"."source_text")) between 1 and 50000 and "style_sources"."content_hash" ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'

tarot_version_bounds.name: tarot_version_bounds
tarot_version_bounds.value: "tarot_deck_versions"."version">0 and "tarot_deck_versions"."status" in ('DRAFT','PUBLISHED','RETIRED') and jsonb_typeof("tarot_deck_versions"."manifest")='object' and octet_length("tarot_deck_versions"."manifest"::text)<=20000 and "tarot_deck_versions"."manifest"->>'deckKey'="tarot_deck_versions"."deck_key" and ("tarot_deck_versions"."manifest"->>'version')::integer="tarot_deck_versions"."version" and "tarot_deck_versions"."manifest"->>'status'="tarot_deck_versions"."status"

tarot_deck_bounds.name: tarot_deck_bounds
tarot_deck_bounds.value: "tarot_decks"."key" ~ '^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,63}$' and length(trim("tarot_decks"."name")) between 1 and 100 and length("tarot_decks"."description")<=300

usage_cost.name: usage_cost
usage_cost.value: "usage_events"."currency"='USD' and "usage_events"."cost_state" in ('estimated','known_zero','unknown') and (("usage_events"."cost_state"='unknown')=("usage_events"."amount_nanos" is null)) and "usage_events"."amount_nanos">=0
